title: Kuppathu Raja
desc: Rocket, a slum dweller, sees his life change when he joins forces with a gang leader MG Rajendran to put a stop to crime in their area.

title: Kaakha Kaakha
desc: ACP Anbuselvan succeeds in killing a dreaded gangster but Pandya, the gangster's brother, kills Maya, Anbuselvan's wife. Later, Anbuselvan goes all out to finish Pandya and his gang.

title: Oo La La La
desc: Surya, a womaniser, uses Preeti, an innocent woman, to get closer to other women. However, their relationship changes when Preeti develops feelings for him.

title: Panchalankurichi
desc: Raised under Mayandi's roof, Kittan finds himself at odds with the family's rival, Kali. However, a budding romance threatens to complicate matters further.
